# Brand Marketian

> Brand Marketian (brandmarketian.com) is a growth marketing agency based in New Delhi, India. It builds brands from scratch, then runs social media, Meta and Google ads, SEO, influencer marketing and WhatsApp/CRM follow-up as one accountable, month-to-month system. Clients own their ad accounts and assets, with no lock-in. "Brand Marketian" is the company's name, not a misspelling of "brand marketing".

Brand Marketian works with D2C, retail, service and B2B brands across India, building tracked, revenue-linked marketing systems rather than one-off campaigns. Engagements start within 10 working days, each service can be taken standalone, and reporting is tied to a jointly-defined qualified lead, not raw form fills.

## Key facts

- Name: Brand Marketian (also written Brandmarketian)
- Type: Growth marketing / digital marketing agency
- Location: New Delhi, India; serves clients across India
- Languages: English and Hindi
- Pricing: Launch ₹24,999/month, Growth ₹49,999/month, Dominate ₹89,999/month, plus custom partnerships (excl. 18% GST; ad spend billed separately)
- Contract: month-to-month, 30 days' notice, client owns ad accounts
- Contact: growth@brandmarketian.com, +91 96506 18193
- Brands worked with (see Work page): Libas, First Fiddle, Sri Sai Convention Hall, Divine Home India, and creator campaigns for national consumer brands

## Services

- [All services](https://brandmarketian.com/services): Ten services, one accountable team.
- [Performance marketing agency in India](https://brandmarketian.com/services/performance-marketing): Meta, Google and YouTube ads judged on cost per qualified lead and ROAS.
- [SEO agency in Delhi NCR and India](https://brandmarketian.com/services/seo): Technical SEO, commercial content, local SEO and AI search visibility.
- [Social media marketing agency](https://brandmarketian.com/services/social-media-marketing): Calendar, reels and community management in English and Hinglish.
- [D2C growth marketing](https://brandmarketian.com/services/d2c-growth): From first order to repeat buyer, measured on margin.
- [B2B lead generation](https://brandmarketian.com/services/b2b-lead-generation): Pipeline reported through to closed deals.
- [Influencer & creator marketing](https://brandmarketian.com/influencer-marketing): Nano to celebrity creators across Instagram and YouTube, measured with UTMs and promo codes.
- [Industries served](https://brandmarketian.com/industries): D2C, B2B and local business playbooks.
- [Pricing](https://brandmarketian.com/pricing): Retainer plans and what each includes.
